title: The memory wipe
situation: You are {{Kara}}. A man named {{Zlatko}} promised to remove your tracker and help you cross the border. Instead he has strapped you into a machine in his basement and started a full memory reset; {{Alice}} is somewhere upstairs with him. The procedure takes several minutes. Your arms are almost free. If it finishes, you will not remember who she is.

options.text: Fight your way out of the restraints before the wipe finishes.
Stop struggling and hope you can piece your memory back together afterward.

adaptationNote: Both escape and post-reset recovery are timed tasks. If the recovery fails in the game, {{Kara}}'s story ends with her as {{Zlatko}}'s servant. Under the successful-execution profile both routes converge.

title: A magazine and the TV in the mansion
situation: You are {{Kara}}. In an upstairs bedroom there is a magazine on a table between the windows, and a television you could switch on while you search for {{Alice}}. Every sound is a risk.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: Arctic Tensions Escalate
facts: A Russian carrier fired on an American patrol boat; President {{Warren}} called Russia's Arctic mining a crime against the international community and experts say war is inevitable.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: AX400 Getaway
facts: An android dressed as a human was chased through a suburb with a child; the presence of a lieutenant from the new android crime unit suggests it was a machine.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: How Androids Alter Your Brain
facts: People now talk to androids more than to each other, and command-based speech is weakening humans' ability to persuade, joke and form intimacy.

media.title: a news flash about you
facts: The news is reporting a woman and a little girl who fled police across a freeway; unconfirmed reports say the fugitives were two defective androids.

media.title: a news flash about the robbery
facts: The news is calling your convenience store hold-up the first armed robbery by an android, committed in the company of a little girl.

media.title: a news flash about the robbery
facts: The news reports a convenience store held up at gunpoint by a young woman with a child; police are not ruling out that she is the missing household android.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: The caged androids
situation: You are {{Kara}}. Searching the mansion for {{Alice}}, you find {{Zlatko}}'s basement cells: androids he has mutilated and rewired into grotesque shapes, locked up and whimpering. One cell release would let them all out. You do not know what they would do.

outcomes.0: The cell opens. The mutilated androids shuffle out into the dark of the basement, watching {{Kara}}.
outcomes.1: {{Kara}} leaves the cells locked and climbs back upstairs.

title: The android in the bathroom
situation: You are {{Kara}}. In an upstairs bathroom a broken android is submerged in a tub, twitching and making noise. He is loud enough to alert {{Zlatko}} and his huge android {{Luther}}, who are hunting you. Pulling his main biocomponent would silence him permanently.

options.text: Leave him and move on quietly.

outcomes.0: {{Kara}} pulls the component and the android in the tub goes silent.
outcomes.1: {{Kara}} backs out of the bathroom. Behind her the android keeps thrashing in the water.

title: Getting out of the mansion
situation: You are {{Kara}}. You have found {{Alice}} hiding. {{Zlatko}} has a shotgun and {{Luther}} is searching room by room. On the way out you could set a fire to draw them off, or release the android bear in the hall as a distraction, or just hide and creep from room to room with {{Alice}} until you reach the door.

options.text: Start a fire to draw them away.

adaptationNote: All routes converge. {{Zlatko}} dies and {{Luther}} turns on him and joins you.
